name: Freedom Arrow — 0.8 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.8: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.8.0-dev.14: HJ-10 is a semi-active Hellfire that fires at spotted enemies without its own line of sight (runtime hook); CH-901 is a CTL-181-style munition. Includes the dev.8 aircraft batch and CTL-181 NLOS (8 damage, 1800 m). Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.0.
